packages.card_description: A ten-day luxury circuit through Colombo, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella, Yala, and Galle with Ayurveda rituals and elegant stays.
packages.overview: This longer Ayurveda journey turns the wellness concept into a broad luxury circuit. It keeps Colombo, tea country, and restorative treatments at the core, then layers in Ella's viewpoints, a Yala safari experience, and a refined finish on the southern coast for travelers who want indulgence with variety.

highlights.title: Luxury Wellness Core
highlights.description: Maintain a steady rhythm of fine hotels, Ayurveda therapies, herbal rituals, and easy-paced travel throughout the route.

highlights.title: Tea Country and Ella
highlights.description: Blend expert tea tasting, scenic rail travel, and Ella's mountain viewpoints into the wellness journey.

highlights.title: Safari and Southern Coast
highlights.description: Add Yala's wildlife frontier and a stylish Galle coast finish without losing the luxury tone of the tour.

itinerary.title: Days 01-02: Colombo Luxury Arrival
itinerary.description: Begin in Colombo with VIP arrival support, fine dining, Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Galle Face Green, shopping, and optional spa experiences.
details: Meal Plan: Breakfast and selected meals
Travel Time: Airport transfer and city touring

itinerary.title: Day 03: Colombo to Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive into the hill capital, check into a luxury hillside resort, visit the Temple of the Tooth, and enjoy an evening cultural performance.
details: Meal Plan: Breakfast and selected meals
Travel Time: Colombo to Kandy - inland transfer

itinerary.title: Days 04-05: Nuwara Eliya Tea and Ayurveda
itinerary.description: Travel through tea estates to Nuwara Eliya for plantation visits, tea factory insights, private tasting, and a full Ayurveda wellness program with massage and herbal therapies.
details: Accommodation: Nuwara Eliya colonial-style luxury hotel
Meal Plan: Breakfast and selected meals
Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - scenic highland drive

itinerary.description: Take the mountain train to Ella, settle into a boutique luxury stay, then visit Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam's Peak with time for photography, light hiking, or an optional spa session.
details: Meal Plan: Breakfast and selected meals

Transport Mode: Train and private luxury vehicle

itinerary.title: Day 08: Yala Safari Lodge
itinerary.description: Drive to Yala National Park for a luxury safari-lodge stay and a jeep safari focused on elephants, leopards, and dry-zone wildlife.
details: Meal Plan: Breakfast and selected meals

Transport Mode: Private luxury vehicle and safari jeep

itinerary.description: Continue to the southern coast, check into a beachfront resort, explore Galle Fort, and keep the evening for sunset dining by the ocean.
details: Accommodation: Galle or south-coast luxury resort

packages.card_description: A short beach route through Bentota and Mirissa or Hikkaduwa with river life, surfing, snorkeling, and whale-watching waters.
packages.overview: This quick coastal break heads straight into Sri Lanka's beach belt for soft sand, sea-life excursions, and time on the water. It is best for travelers who want a compact beach-focused holiday with a mix of relaxation, marine activities, and a little south-coast movement.

highlights.title: Surf and Snorkel South

highlights.title: Whale-Watching Morning
highlights.description: Use the final morning for a Mirissa whale-watching excursion before the return to Colombo.

packages.overview: This longer coastal itinerary follows Sri Lanka's western and southern shoreline in a more unhurried rhythm. It combines beach downtime, marine excursions, historic Galle, and several distinct resort towns so travelers can experience the coast as a full holiday rather than a quick add-on.

highlights.title: Galle, Unawatuna, and Mirissa

highlights.title: Hikkaduwa Marine Finish
